description: Kaleido app theming catalog. Each entry renders a Noctalia/matugen-compatible template with the active palette.

templates.name: Kitty
templates.post_hook: mkdir -p "$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/kitty"; f="$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/kitty/kitty.conf"; touch "$f"; grep -qxF 'include kaleido.conf' "$f" || printf '\ninclude kaleido.conf\n' >> "$f"
templates.description: Colors for the Kitty terminal. Adds an include line to kitty.conf automatically.

templates.name: Alacritty
templates.description: Colors for Alacritty. Add `import = ["~/.config/alacritty/kaleido.toml"]` to your alacritty.toml.

templates.name: Foot
templates.description: Colors for the Foot terminal. Reference it with `include=themes/kaleido` inside `[main]` of foot.ini.

templates.name: Ghostty
templates.description: Colors for Ghostty. Load it with `config-file = kaleido` in your Ghostty config.

templates.name: WezTerm
templates.description: Color table for WezTerm. Merge it in wezterm.lua, e.g. `config.colors = dofile(wezterm.config_dir .. '/kaleido.lua')`.

templates.name: btop
templates.description: Theme for btop. Select `kaleido` as the color theme in btop options.

templates.name: Fuzzel
templates.description: Colors for Fuzzel. Add `include=~/.config/fuzzel/kaleido.ini` to fuzzel.ini.

templates.name: Rofi
templates.description: Global color block for Rofi. Import it with `@import "kaleido.rasi"` in your theme.

templates.name: Waybar
templates.description: Stylesheet for Waybar. Adds an @import line to style.css automatically.

templates.name: Mako
templates.description: Colors for the Mako notification daemon. Add `include=~/.config/mako/kaleido` to mako/config.

templates.name: tmux
templates.description: Status bar theme for tmux. Adds a source-file line to tmux.conf automatically.

templates.name: Hyprland
templates.description: Border and shadow colors for Hyprland. Adds a source line to hyprland.conf automatically.

templates.name: Hyprlock
templates.description: Colors for Hyprlock. Add `source = ~/.config/hypr/kaleido-lock.conf` to hyprlock.conf.

templates.name: Obsidian
templates.description: CSS snippet for Obsidian. Enable it under Settings → Appearance → CSS snippets.

templates.name: Qt (qt5ct / qt6ct)
templates.description: Color scheme for qt5ct and qt6ct. Select `kaleido` as the color scheme in either tool.

templates.name: Starship
templates.description: Palette block for the Starship prompt. Copy `[palettes.kaleido]` into starship.toml and set `palette = "kaleido"`.
